title: Thingiverse - Porsche 993 custom split-grille bar
notes: Primary page and Files tab read on 2026-11-07 without login or challenge bypass. The licence explicitly links https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/. The file list contains three V5D STL meshes (complete bar, bottom half, top half) and the complete-bar IPT CAD file. Same asset as SRC-RENN3D-CUSTOM-SPLIT-GRILLE-BAR; count once. The author describes a custom appearance modification requiring other grille changes, not a direct replacement. The stated 357 mm complete length, dowels, insert holes and heat-resistance claims are author declarations, not independently measured or tested inputs. The secondary record's different envelope remains historical and unreconciled. No file was downloaded, imported or opened in a CAD tool; editability, units, dimensional accuracy, attachments, thermal behaviour and fit are not independently verified. Noncommercial and ShareAlike conditions remain mandatory. See docs/research/thingiverse-primary-licences-20261107.md.
